definitions.explanation: Indicates that something will happen after a period of time, but not immediately.

examples.japanese: やがて{春|はる}が{来|く}る。
{子供|こども}はやがて{大人|おとな}になる。
{長|なが}い{冬|ふゆ}が{終|お}わり、やがて{暖|あたた}かい{日|ひ}が{続|つづ}くようになった。
examples.english: The long winter ended, and before long warm days became the norm.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{苦労|くろう}したが、やがて{自分|じぶん}の{会社|かいしゃ}を{持|も}つまでになった。
examples.english: He struggled when he was young, but eventually he came to own his own company.

notes:
USAGE: やがて suggests that something will happen naturally over time, implying a sense of inevitability or gradual progression.

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
・やがて - before long (implies gradual, natural progression)
・まもなく - soon (imminent, about to happen)
・そのうち - eventually (vague future time)
